import sys

def dfs(x, sum):
    num = x // b[sum]
    rem = x % b[sum]
    if rem == 0:
        return num * sum
    left = dfs(rem, sum-1)
    right = sum + dfs(b[sum]-rem, sum-1)
    return num * sum + min(left, right)

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    b = [0] * 20
    for i in range(1, 18):
        b[i] = b[i-1] * 10 + 1
    s = str(n)
    m = len(s)
    print(dfs(n, m + 2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
